title: Kuusi Markdown Preview
description: Linked navigation between Markdown editor and preview.

autoReload.title: Editor auto reload
autoReload.description: When enabled, keep the Markdown preview open and synced to the editor cursor while editing.

activeLineStyle.title: Markdown editor line number highlight
activeLineStyle.description: How the line number of the cursor's line is marked: default, highlight, bold, bar or off.

activeLineColor.title: Markdown editor line number color
activeLineColor.description: Color of the highlighted line number as a CSS hex color; empty uses the Kuusi green.

previewAutoReload.title: Preview auto reload
previewAutoReload.description: When enabled, reload the Markdown preview when the file changes on disk.
